title: Ladybug waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g stroke-linejoin='round'>
    <!-- legs -->
    <path d='M38,68 L28,80' stroke='#3a2b45' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M62,68 L72,80' stroke='#3a2b45' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M40,58 L30,58' stroke='#3a2b45' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M60,58 L70,58' stroke='#3a2b45' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#e8533d'/>
    <path d='M50,26 L50,78' stroke='#3a2b45' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- spots -->
    <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='6' fill='#3a2b45'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='6' fill='#3a2b45'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='62' r='5' fill='#3a2b45'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='62' r='5' fill='#3a2b45'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='13' fill='#3a2b45'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='45' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#fff6e0'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#fff6e0'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='24' r='1.6' fill='#3a2b45'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='24' r='1.6' fill='#3a2b45'/>
    <!-- antennae -->
    <path d='M44,16 L40,7' stroke='#3a2b45' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M56,16 L60,7' stroke='#3a2b45' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='39' cy='6' r='3' fill='#3a2b45'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='6' r='3' fill='#3a2b45'/>
    <!-- waving arm -->
    <path d='M75,40 L84,26' stroke='#3a2b45' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='85' cy='24' r='5' fill='#e8533d'/>
  </g>
</svg>
